Class CraftTweakerText

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerText
public final class CraftTweakerText extends Object
Optional startup-action facade imported as mods.chromaticcodes.Text in ZenScript.

CraftTweaker's annotation scanner discovers this class only when CraftTweaker is installed; common mod startup never links its API. Every published change is a logged IAction using the existing registry's atomic editor. Failed declaration validation preserves prior state. CraftTweaker 1.12's normal loader executes startup scripts once; these methods do not invent an undo or hot-reload protocol. Restart after changing those scripts. GroovyScript's separate facade provides its own real reload lifecycle.

IDs identify this facade's exact contribution. Reusing an ID replaces that owned declaration in one edit. Removal cannot remove a later owner's replacement and does not restore displaced entries. Callbacks, parser behavior and rendering remain the same as Java, Kotlin and Scala. This common API is safe to load on a dedicated server.

    • custom

      public static CraftTweakerText.Effect custom(CraftTweakerText.EffectSampler sampler)
      Creates a script callback with access to all generic effect channels, not just preset options. The sampler runs synchronously wherever the native renderer/layout samples the shared callback. Do not mutate definitions or access client-only state from common-side layout calls.
      Parameters:
      sampler - custom renderer-property callback
      Returns:
      reusable effect description supporting independent playback speed
